name: Our Lady of Lourdes and St Gregory the Great, Farnworth
shortName: Our Lady of Lourdes and St Gregory the Great

boundary.description: From the crossing of River Croal and Hall Lane (A6053), E along the river to the point opposite Kearsley station, and by a bee-line to that station and Stoneclough Road (A667). Along Stoneclough Road (A667) to its junction with Bolton Road and by a beeline to the junction of Moss Road and M61 Motorway (junction 3), then W along M61 Motorway to junction 4, N along Watergate Lane, Plodder Lane, Smerthurst Lane to the point opposite Top O’ Th’ Height Farm on Slackfold Lane, and E along Slackfold Lane to Holme Fold Farm, then by a bee-line to and along Doe Hey Brook and the middle of Higher and Lower Doe Hey Reservoirs, then NW by a bee-line River Croal, including all of Ashby Close estate and crossing the railway the junction of St Peter’s Way and Manchester Road, NW along River Croal to Hall Lane.
